text.title: Brazil
text.summary: Brazil's 1988 Constitution identifies the Brazilian state as the Federative Republic of Brazil.
text.context: This entry uses a constitutional frame of reference. It does not assign a birth date to the country or represent all its historical territorial configurations.

text.title: Portugal
text.summary: Article 1 of the Portuguese Constitution presents Portugal as a sovereign republic.
text.context: Identity is presented according to the constitutional source consulted. This entry does not describe borders in every period or attribute a single political configuration to Portugal throughout its history.

text.title: Brazil: the 1988 constitutional framework
text.summary: Article 1 of Brazil's 1988 Constitution adopts the self-description of a democratic state under the rule of law.
text.context: The label is attributed to the original constitutional text. It is not an assessment of political functioning, a comparative typology, or evidence of the uniform continuity of democratic practices.

text.title: Portugal: the 1976 constitutional framework
text.summary: Article 2 of the consolidated Portuguese constitutional text adopts the self-description of a democratic state under the rule of law.
text.context: The reference constitution is that of 1976; the formulation cited belongs to the consolidated text consulted. The same wording or political practices are not assumed to have applied throughout the entire period.
